# What’s new in OverCue Desktop 2.1.6 for Windows

- Send a support report from Settings or an error, with your description and optional contact details. Reports include private diagnostics and retry until OverCue confirms receipt.
- Stops the remaining batch after an unrecoverable helper startup failure while continuing after track-specific errors.
- Displays helper errors without raw terminal formatting or overflow, and preserves the original exception in diagnostics even when CPU fallback succeeds.
